key_insight: For noisy parity fitting, extra readings of the same source can make a worst-case NP-hard optimization problem exactly tractable without changing its objective or feasible set.
engineering_relevance: In measurement-rich systems matching the paper’s assumptions, collecting more observations can enable exact optimization with near-linear computational work.
method: Model observations as uniformly sampled rank-one sign tensor entries with independent fair factor signs and independent errors.
For fixed interaction order k≥3 and logarithmic mean degree, add O(n/(log n)^(1/(k−2))) readings to achieve exact optimization in O(n log² n) worst-case work with high probability.
Use a common signed-field law to characterize objective gains, tied optima and reweighting dimension, and residual-coordinate geometry to characterize local verification.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical high-probability guarantees and a sharp leading coefficient for weak recovery by depth-O(log log n) local estimators with independent reading marks, rather than empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The guarantees rely on structured random sampling, independence assumptions and known channel biases; applicability beyond these conditions is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: From NP-Hardness to Exact Tractability Through Sample Abundance
